windows_lxml.provenance_note: The official September wheel does not identify its static iconv version. Releases instead build lxml from its exact PyPI sdist with the four SHA-256/size-pinned official 2026.05.17 native assets; a deterministic local patch disables latest-release selection. A RECORD-bound receipt must bind these actual inputs, helper/patch, source recipe and compiled native output hashes.
